title: Sparking an Appreciation for Arthropods Through Video Games: The Journey of Creating Bug & Seek
content: There is something beautiful and wonderful about seeing the joy of a child discovering a curious bug for the first time. That joy was the initial impetus for us to develop Bug & Seek, a video game in which you, the player, catch over 200 different species of arthropods to build up the collection in your insectarium. (The game features insects, arachnids, isopods, myriapods, and even a non‐arthropod flat‐ worm—but we’ll just refer to them as “bugs” for ease.) You can also donate bugs to a local university, the Entomological Institute of Insect Education, which even features a (fictional) world‐renowned entomologist, Dr. Madeline, who refuses to provide autographs, since—as you know—entomologists are so often mobbed by adoring fans in public places (Fig. 1).
